eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

hashEmptyLaunch((bytes32,bytes32,address.notice: Empty snapshots require a distinct admission signature: a relayer cannot strip settlement.

issuanceAuthorizationOf(address).notice: Binds an issued token to the complete signed snapshot and issuance parameters.

launch((bytes32,bytes32,address,bytes32,.notice: The signed issuer wallet submits the launch and pays the signed native fee. The signed payer is the issuer: the only address that may later start early release.

launchWithEmptyAllocation((bytes32,bytes.notice: Zero-eligible snapshot path: launch and signed full-airdrop redirection are atomic. A regular launch authorization alone can never authorize redirection to the treasury.

platformAuthority().notice: Immutable platform Safe supplied as a named deployment parameter. Safe executes a transaction; an admission signature or its owner's EOA is not this authority.

reserveProposalUsed(bytes32).notice: Global to this Launcher, across both buckets and every Hana. Zero-amount executions consume IDs.

withdrawReserve(bytes32,uint8,address,ui.notice: Platform-controlled buckets, without a vesting schedule or recipient-purpose policy. Only this issuance's Launcher inventory can be debited; no external-asset rescue or pull exists.
